turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided to give Owen a zero, and why did nobody call me first?
Before we start, I reread Owen's last three essays this morning.
This morning. The zero went in on November 3, so you read them after you'd already decided.
He writes like someone who was read to every night. That was you, wasn't it?
Don't. What do you have on Owen's essay, Hale?
You've raised a genuinely thoughtful kid. I mean that.
Then why did he find out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class? I didn't come for compliments.
Which is why I'd hate for this to become a fight between two people who obviously both care about him.
You made it a fight when you entered the zero. Evidence, or I'm going to the principal.
